mentions.name: AI Agent Progress Notifier
mentions.description: A notifier for AI agents that understands what an agent is: it periodically sends progress updates plus proof-of-work artifacts like screenshots and plan.md files for review on the go, and lets users approve certain agent decisions while the agents keep running in autopilot. One-click shell install with an iOS mobile app; Android is coming soon.
mentions.problem: Existing tools like Pushover and ntfy.sh don't know what an agent is, forcing users to babysit terminals; this notifier is the missing harness piece that removes that babysitting.
mentions.audience: Runs AI agents on the user's behalf, sending periodic progress notifications and proof-of-work artifacts (screenshots, plan.md, etc.) so work can be reviewed on the go. It supports approving certain agent decisions without stopping autopilot mode, ships as a one-click install (curl | sh) with an iOS mobile app, and an Android app is coming soon.
mentions.source_excerpt:
A notifier which knows what agent is, allows you to approve certain decisions you'd want to be part of, while still running the agents in autopilot mode.

It periodically notifies you about agent progress & moreover, sends you proof of work artefacts like screenshots, plan.md etc files so you can review on the go.
